instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for E2E testing reliability.
Use Phosphor icons (@phosphor-icons/react) or Lucide React for a premium, consistent icon set.
Avoid typical purple/blue gradients entirely to maintain the distinct high-end cinematic feel.
Implement 'Clash Display' for headings and 'Satoshi' for body text using the provided Fontshare links.
For horizontal scrolling rails (like Netflix UI), ensure scrollbars are hidden and padding is handled to not clip hover scales.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the creative marketing/home views, and rely on Shadcn UI (heavily customized) for the Wallet and Dashboard dense tables.
